entities.summary: Helene Thomas Bennett was an American bacteriologist and businesswoman who worked in Arizona. She opened the Yuma Clinical Laboratory in 1926, in Yuma, Arizona, which became the second largest medical laboratory in Arizona. She was posthumously inducted into the Arizona Women's Hall of Fame in 2011.
